title: Cross-Layer Censorship Event Database
description: A curated catalog of crypto censorship events (OFAC SDN, DOJ, SEC/CFTC, nation-state, corporate, supranational) tracked across six independent layers — network (L0), consensus (L1), RPC (L3), frontend (L4), asset on-chain, and off-ramp CEX — with precision-aware timelines; hour-or-better precision is reported only for the named subset that supports it. Admission requires one primary source or two independent semi-primary sources per layer-level observation, and admission-grade web evidence carries a replayable Wayback URL or local sha256 body_hash anchor where required by the validation contract. Released under an open schema plus validator so other researchers can extend the catalog.
